CustomField.label: Value To Test (list checks only)
CustomField.description: Required for a Check records with a query check using the "List includes any of" / "List excludes all of" operators: enter the formula that returns the value to test against the list from the Second Query (e.g. BillingCountry). Leave blank for every other Check Type.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: List checks only ("List includes any of" / "List excludes all of"). Return the single value to test against the Second Query list, e.g. BillingCountry. Leave blank for Check fields on this record and all other query checks.
